name: Moka 组织变更
description_zh: 面向组织管理与人事负责人的组织变更事前盘点与方案确认。当用户说「要停用某个部门」「新建部门并设负责人」「把部门挪到另一条线」「给某员工调岗」「组织架构重组」等变更意图时使用：先澄清变更对象与生效日期，再盘点影响面（子部门、部门在职员工名单、编制与汇报关系），向用户复述影响面并逐项确认处理方式。本技能只做事前盘点与方案确认，不执行任何变更；执行动作一律引导用户到 Moka 页面完成。
description_en: Pre-change assessment and plan confirmation for org-management and HR leaders. Use it when the user intends to change the org structure — disabling, creating, transferring or enabling a department, updating department fields, transferring an employee, or planning a batch restructure. It clarifies the change intent, assesses the impact (sub-departments, active employees, headcount and reporting relations), and confirms the plan with the user item by item. It performs the assessment only and never executes changes; execution is always directed to the Moka client.
